formula.day_spread_h: per (year, day) and 24 hourly energy prices c (EUR/MWh, planning.cost_energy_p[year][day] row): spread_h(c) = mean of the h highest c_t - mean of the h lowest c_t (sorted; W19 Z4 / W22 definition, p515_s47_market_spreads.day_spreads for h = 4; checked bitwise)
formula.profiles: mean_profile: spread_h(cbar), cbar[t] = sum_s pi_m[s] c[s, t] (the EV price profile); draw0: spread_h(c[0]) (scenario row 0 = the published SRP1 single scenario, gate (a)); s1, s2: rows 1, 2; expected: sum_s pi_m[s] spread_h(c[s]) (ensemble expectation of per-scenario spreads)
formula.horizon: H = sum_b w_b spread_b / sum_b w_b over the 12 (year, day) blocks; w_u = num_years[y] * num_days[d] ("day-weighted", undiscounted); w_r2 = w_u / 1.02^(y - 2025) ("discount-weighted", the model block weight, production DiscountFactor 0.02) -- p515_s47_market_spreads.weights / .horizon, as W52 (p515_s53_3x3_selection.py) used them
formula.ratios: R_mean = H(mean_profile) / H(draw0); R_expected = H(expected) / H(draw0); mean_over_expected = H(mean_profile) / H(expected); each for w_u and w_r2, h = 4 and h = 2
